space.expression: poly(input size) online working space and stored compact-basis advice

notes: The gain is a polynomial-space representation and query algorithm, not a smaller unrestricted CVP time exponent. Every lattice has an n²-compact basis, but the source leaves efficient construction without computing the Voronoi cell as an open problem. All preprocessing needed to supply the basis is excluded from the query bound.

extra.compactness: Input c-compact basis; every Voronoi-relevant vector lies in B[-c,c]^n
extra.preprocessing: Unbounded advice preparation excluded; advice consists of B and c
extra.target: Arbitrary target for the fixed lattice
extra.model: Deterministic exact CVPP; Voronoi-vector superset enumerated as needed

evidence.locator: Corollary 4.1 and discussion following it; Theorem 2.4; Problem 4.2
